capabilities: : Sync blocks tagged with a specific tag
: Sync notes to Readwise as highlights
: Deep link synced blocks to Obsidian notes
: Sync blocks in the current file
disambiguation: It sync notes into Readwise, unlike the official Readwise plugin which sync highlights from Readwise to Obsidian.
extras: Warning: Renaming or moving a note in Readwise will cause existing synced highlights to duplicate.
motivation: The author is an avid Readwise user who built it as a hobby project to review personal notes about focus-first technology and other topics.
problem: Users need a way to export specific, tagged notes from Obsidian into Readwise for spaced repetition review.
summary: A plugin that sync blocks tagged with a specific tag to Readwise as highlights for spaced repetition review.
